WIC20A-01.note: 'already ... long before' plus one-in-a-thousand persistence gives present-at-low-frequency; arising contradicts 'already', advancing contradicts steady persistence, beneficial contradicts predators favoring armor.

WIC20A-02.note: Looks strong but loses fights: a bluff. 'Badges' is a near-miss (a signal) but lacks the deception that the fight data establishes; armaments contradicted by losing.

WIC20A-03.note: Sideways pressure plus arches and troughs = buckled; corroded and crystallized fall to 'pressure' alone, ascended is a surface echo of 'rise'.

WIC20A-04.note: Individual firsthand stories never compiled = anecdotal; 'circumstantial' is a strong near-miss killed by 'witnessed directly' (circumstantial evidence is indirect).

WIC20A-05.note: Open passages carrying dye 9 km in a day contrast with filters: conduits. 'Agents of contamination' is the only collocational rival but passages carry rather than cause it.

WIC20A-06.note: Contrast with 'happens fast' and a decade of steady decline = chronic; cyclic is the only near-miss and 'fell steadily' rules it out.

WIC20A-07.note: Tests a fixed technical compound ('seed bank'); 'drawn on ... replenished' alone settles it. Closer to term recall than to a WIC word-in-context judgment; 'seed bed' is the only lure.

WIC20A-08.note: Matching shared ash layers so equal moments can be compared = align; authenticate is the only plausible rival and is not what matching layers achieves.

WIC20A-09.note: Requires combining the speed-carries-grain-size rule with 'grew steadily faster': coarse. Cohesive (clay) points the wrong way; angular is a real sediment property not tied to speed here.

WIC20A-10.note: Silt layers meters deep over the village = buried; 'while preserving it' plus 'dig it out' makes it near-immediate; besieged/bathed are surface flood words.

WIC20B-01.note: Calculated restraint from enforcing a known right, then prompt enforcement when rates tripled = forbearance; diffidence and humility are near-misses killed by the deliberate cost judgment and the later confident suit.

WIC20B-02.note: New riders were former walkers and cyclists, so free fares shifted them to buses: diverted. Inconvenienced/disappointed contradict free benefit; insulated has no support.

WIC20B-03.note: The appositive 'shaped ... by a wish to speak well of their street' alone gives flattering; earnest is the reverse of the conclusion.

WIC20B-04.note: Declining to overrule but confining the precedent to shop leases is the legal sense of 'distinguished'; eclipsed is killed by 'still governs', invoked/endorsed by not applying it. Uncommon sense of a common word, which is on-blueprint.

WIC20B-05.note: Earlier account blamed slow growth on distance; rail line showed it was not the deciding factor, though genuine: decisive. Illusory is a strong trap contradicted by 'genuine burden'.

WIC20B-06.note: Undated letters plus molds replaced every 8-12 years dates each letter to roughly a decade; destination/intent/genre have no link to watermarks.

WIC20B-07.note: A remark on a question 'expressly left open' is dicta, outside the court's holding, so it binds no later court; requires knowing the legal sense of 'holding'. Influence is a near-miss but the remark plainly has influence (commentators cite it).

WIC20B-08.note: Buried household caches of pure coins = hoarded (Gresham's law); exchanged contradicts 'paid out ... whenever they could' contrast.

WIC20B-09.note: Hourly pay penalizing speed = little incentive; 'pay scheme gave ... little ___ to work quickly' nearly decides it alone.

WIC20B-10.note: Legal vote exercised at high turnout but coerced = hollow (form without substance); dormant killed by high turnout, fragile is a near-miss but the right was not at risk of loss, it was empty.

WIC20C-01.note: Heat arrives in the evening and is vented: delayed, not refused = postpone. Neutralize is a near-miss but the heat still arrives.

WIC20C-02.note: Three minutes per side, 'roughly the old size' = length; key/opening/meter have no support.

WIC20C-03.note: Recurring unexplained hints, never stated = oblique; momentary killed by 'again and again', melodramatic by 'without comment', lavish is the nearest lure.

WIC20C-04.note: Line-by-line comparison of a free retelling contrasted with 'faithful to the spirit' = loose; lofty contradicts 'everyday English', lively is not the contrast with faithful.

WIC20C-05.note: Later applications cited and copied it = pattern (precedent/model); mandate overstates authority, pretext implies a false excuse.

WIC20C-06.note: Narrowing the praise to abstractions without withdrawing it = qualify; 'rather than to abandon it' strikes jeopardize/muddle, probe is the near-miss.

WIC20C-07.note: A student can 'tell the original from every change' = history kept legible; pristine is the strong lure but the building is visibly altered.

WIC20C-08.note: Single viola fading vs. usual loudest close = quiet; the frame '___ without being weak' with this context leaves only quiet.

WIC20C-09.note: Early scene foreshadows the later one = prologue (prelude would be tighter); memorial points backward in time, obstacle/objection unsupported.

WIC20C-10.note: Hanging as 'a single day passing' imposes a sequence/story the painter avoided = narrative; monotony is the only lure.

WIC20D-01.note: Dashboard vs. drawer, temperature-driven reactions = surroundings; usage is struck as a restatement of 'how often it is charged'.

WIC20D-02.note: Dropping non-adherent and placebo responders = trim the population; randomize is a domain-flavored trap (it happens later), train echoes 'habit'. 'Trim' is slightly informal for the register.

WIC20D-03.note: Any of six orders allowed by grammar = unrestricted; random is the strong trap killed by writers choosing orders for emphasis and 'far from meaningless'.

WIC20D-04.note: Every vehicle however light opens cracks and inspectors count cycles = volume; weight is the strong trap the first sentence explicitly rejects.

WIC20D-05.note: Catching errors the old method missed = spot; rate/sample/rank do not collocate with catching errors, so the item is nearly free.

WIC20D-06.note: Anxiety pushes office readings systematically high = skewed; rough is a defensible-sounding rival (imprecise) but the passage describes directional bias, not noise. Watch whether graders accept 'rough'.

WIC20D-07.note: Vowels inserted, syllables added = reshaped; shortened is the reverse, rejected contradicts borrowing, translated is the domain lure.

WIC20D-08.note: Deck lengthens in summer and contracts in winter, so 'shift' covers both directions; 'stretch' fits the summer half and is arguably acceptable for thermal expansion, so exclusivity is weak. Possible key dispute.

WIC20D-09.note: 'Giving up ... in exchange for a branded look' frames a deliberate trade = spending the redundancy; wasting is a close rival but implies nothing gained. Scrambling/repeating unsupported.

WIC20D-10.note: Same path as 'very', whose sense of truth faded = waning; spreading is its opposite, splitting/reversing unsupported.
